note.title: Support workflow with Northwind

utterances.text: Thanks for making time. I'd like to walk through how your team handles support tickets today.
Sure. Right now everything lands in one shared inbox and we sort it by hand every morning.
How many tickets come in on a normal day?
Around two hundred. On Mondays it is closer to four hundred.
And what happens to the urgent ones?
Honestly, they wait like the rest. That is the part that worries me most.
Would a tag for urgent tickets help, or do you need them routed to one person?
Routing would be better. Maya leads the on-call rota, so she should get them first.
Got it. I'll send a short proposal with routing rules by Friday.
Great. Could you also include pricing for a team of twelve?

summary.title: Support workflow with Northwind
summary.short: Sam and Jordan went through how Northwind's support team sorts tickets today. Everything lands in one inbox and urgent tickets wait like the rest. They agreed routing urgent tickets to the on-call lead would help, and Sam will send a proposal with pricing by Friday.
summary.long:
Sam opened by asking how the support team handles tickets today. Jordan explained that every ticket lands in one shared inbox that the team sorts by hand each morning.

Volume is around two hundred tickets a day, closer to four hundred on Mondays. Urgent tickets get no special treatment, which Jordan named as the biggest worry.

Sam offered a tag or routing. Jordan preferred routing urgent tickets to Maya, who leads the on-call rota. Sam will send a proposal with routing rules and pricing for a team of twelve by Friday.
